thread:
Anna Li: Heads-up: seeing steady perf drift on paged-attn under steady-state long-context load. Suspect KV page allocator fragmentation + small-slab churn. Repro steps + logs below. /cc @Mike R @Jordan K :eyes:
Mike R: Can you paste the heapmap/alloc stats? Which branch? Is this in prod canary?
Anna Li: Repro on dedicated canary (region-us-west). Workload: long-chat sweep with 6k token histories from ~20k concurrent ephemeral sessions. From perf logs: KV page free list spikes, >40% tiny-frag pages. Snapshot:
```
alloc_stats:
  slab_size: 64k
  free_pages: 372
  small_frag_pages: 154
  avg_free_ratio: 0.62
pager_events:
  page_evictions/sec: 12.4
  page_reads/sec: 97.1
```
Jordan K: That slab_size looks small for large KV entries. Have we tried hybrid slab/hint allocator? Also are we doing active compaction sweeps?
Anna Li: We have a deferred compaction that runs every 5m. I tried toggling to 1m locally and saw drop in small_frag_pages but CPU increased 6%. Bench numbers:
```
bench: compact_interval=300s -> p99 latency +7%
bench: compact_interval=60s  -> p99 latency +3%, CPU +6%
```
Priya S: Could we do a heartbeat-triggered compaction only when free_ratio < 0.5 and page_evictions > 10/s? So compaction is conditional.
Mike R: Yeah conditional compaction + scavenger that merges adjacent small fragments sounds good. Also consider bumping slab size for paged-attn worker threads.
Anna Li: Proof-of-concept patch WIP: change slab_size from 64k to 256k for paged-attn kernel; add heartbeat compaction with hysteresis. Patch link: https://git.redwood/repo/patch/2343 (private) Bench results on canary:
```
canary-results:
  slab_64k,compact_300s: p50=12ms p95=32ms p99=78ms cost=1.0x
  slab_256k,compact_conditional: p50=11ms p95=29ms p99=62ms cost=0.98x
  notes: reduced page_evictions by 38%, memory overhead +4%
```
Jordan K: Nice. Any regressions for short-chat workloads (common case)?
Anna Li: Short chats unchanged in latency, throughput stable. Risk: memory overhead could bump OOM under tight nodes. Plan: run 24h dedicated canary with new allocator + telemetry (free_ratio, frag_ratio, compactions_run).
Mike R: Add metric: compaction_cpu_ms and compaction_scans. Also add a fallback to old allocator if compaction_cpu_ms > 100ms/s for >60s.
benchbot: Scheduled canary job: canary-paged-allocator-2068 started by @Anna Li. Logs available at https://bench.redwood/canary/2068
Priya S: :thumbsup: If canary looks good, we should gate rollout behind perf-dashboard alert: frag_ratio > 0.5 for 10m.
Anna Li: Will update PR with metrics + fallback. I'll post updated numbers in ~12h. Thanks team.
